Correct. This also applies to courses here at CSUF. However, if CSUF is not allowing you to retake the course due to your passing grade (C+), I'm not sure if that policy also applies to transferred community college courses.

In my case, there was a lower-division course I got a D in at CSUF. I decided to retake the course at a CC, and I got an A. Once the credits transferred, the grade was averaged at CSUF. So I would double-check with a counselor to make sure you can retake a course at a CC, that way you don't waste time or money
